_comment: Bridge-2 campaign build manifest. The campaign ports C++ into an EXISTING Rust crate
(crates/compiler/deeptools); there is no C build to configure, no shim to compile and no
FFI boundary, so `configure` is a no-op and the C-side gates in the translator playbook
⛔ TRANSLATOR GATE — run EXACTLY these two, from the repo root:
Both are seconds-to-a-minute: `deeptools` has one path dependency (sys-arch-spec) and no
registry deps. DO NOT run the workspace-wide or acceptance build in an agent worktree —
its target/ is ~6 GB and there is under 50 GB free on this host; the orchestrator owns
that gate and runs it once per landed sub-campaign.
⛔ THE SPECIFIED ACCEPTANCE COMMAND DOES NOT BUILD ON THIS HOST:
`superdsc` on the CLI turns on scratchy-serving-worker/sendnn -> flex-rs, whose build.rs
cc-compiles a senlib shim against /opt/ibm/spyre/senlib/include — Spyre-host-only headers
that do not exist on this Mac (measured: fatal error: 'senlib/1p0/senpci.hpp' file not
found). The `pipeline` command below is the largest runnable prefix that still expands
#[forward] and therefore still runs this bridge over every staged program.
